# massdriver_event_types (Data Source)

The catalog of events that Massdriver records in the audit log. Use it to check the `event_types` of a `massdriver_event_destination`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "massdriver_event_types" "all" {}

locals {
  event_types = ["deployment.completed", "deployment.failed"]
}

resource "massdriver_event_destination" "audit" {
  name        = "Audit"
  adapter     = "HTTP"
  config      = jsonencode({ url = "https://hooks.example.com/massdriver" })
  event_types = local.event_types

  lifecycle {
    precondition {
      condition     = alltrue([for t in local.event_types : contains(data.massdriver_event_types.all.ids, t)])
      error_message = "Every event type must be in the event catalog."
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `entity` (String) Only list the event types of this entity, such as `deployment`.

### Read-Only

- `event_types` (List of Object) The event types, sorted by id. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--event_types))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ids` (List of String) The event type ids, sorted.
